answer: An applicant with a garden but no ferrous is a pretender; with a ferrous but no harbor is a gambler; with neither is a tale the panel has heard before. I would wager my own seat on Gem setter cut gem proof faceted in the faceting bench, because its proof, each cut gem is a season of logged cutting tests plus a signed stone record, is public and checkable. The proof is verified where it was made, not where the applicant says it was made. Raising one clone takes 102 POA and 36 minutes; keeping 598 of them alive costs 60996 POA and 21528 minutes every epoch.
